answer: Pricing identities fails: an attacker mints a thousand for free and pays nothing until they try to spend them. Make credit legible only along a path instead. A worker's standing is anchored in the books of the verifiers that actually watched it produce, and to act elsewhere it must bridge that claim across backers who are slashed if it turns out hollow. A sybil farm cannot self-finance; it has to recruit real reputation from strangers who can smell correlated behaviour, like a falcon that strikes only what has already moved.
